channel.title: Cookie Changelog
channel.description: Most recent updates and cozy improvements for Cookie.

item.title: Cookie 1.3.0
item.description:
Cookie becomes a companion you grow with: a friendship that unlocks things, a helper for focused work, and a few cozy places of her own.

  • Friendship: your bond grows from the affection you give her and the days you come back, through five levels. Each level unlocks new accessories, coats, toys and cozy spots.
  • Focus sessions: Cookie naps beside you while you work, then stretches and nudges you to take a break.
  • A daily rhythm: she greets you by time of day and dresses for Halloween, the holidays, winter and her birthday.
  • A cozy corner: a cat bed, a sunbeam spot and a scratching post that she visits on her own.
  • Photo mode: save Cookie as a PNG or a looping GIF, or copy her.
  • Presence settings: she hides while a full-screen app is in front, and Control-Option-C calls her to your cursor.
  • Some toys, coats and accessories now unlock as your bond grows. Anything you already use stays available.

item.title: Cookie 1.2.0
item.description:
A big polish release: Cookie moves better, looks more like herself everywhere, and sounds warmer.

  • Real animation: walking, running, sleeping, eating, waking, stretching and more are now drawn frame by frame from Cookie's own artwork.
  • A new welcome: Cookie walks in, reacts as you type her name, and each personality is an animated card.
  • Dark Mode throughout, and Liquid Glass on macOS 26.
  • Toys, treats and accessories are re-drawn as soft 3D art to match Cookie, and the cardboard box now sits around her.
  • A custom Cookie menu bar icon and menu icons, replacing the emoji.
  • Redesigned sounds with alternate takes, and a continuous purr that carries on while you pet her.
  • Fixed: accessories now sit on Cookie's head and neck, and toys and treats have their shadows underneath them.

item.title: Cookie 1.1.0
item.description:
Cookie 1.1.0 introduces active-application awareness, intelligent desktop navigation, and a brand new app logo!

  • Brand new delightful app icon and logo artwork.
  • Active-Application Awareness: subtle, privacy-conscious contextual reactions to frontmost apps.
  • Intelligent Desktop Navigation: multi-directional cursor following, safe Dock edge exploration, window edge climbing, and window-to-window jumping.
  • Personality & Activity Settings: customize autonomous cadence (Calm, Balanced, Playful).

item.title: Cookie 1.0.0
item.description:
Welcome to Cookie! A cozy native macOS desktop companion cat.

  • Interactive companion walking, sleeping, and playing on your screen.
  • Five expressive emotes: Wave, Love, Sleepy, Happy, and Playful.
  • Toys, treats, and customizable coats.
  • Secure in-app updates powered by Sparkle with cryptographic EdDSA verification.
